recognize_zh: 周邊血液中數顆小至中型淋巴細胞，核質比高、染色質凝集，細胞質極少，細胞邊緣可見小的細胞質突起（blebs）；小細胞外觀但帶有細胞質突起，是 T-PLL 小細胞變異型常見的線索。
features: Small to intermediate lymphoid cells with very high N:C ratio
Scant basophilic cytoplasm with small surface blebs/protrusions
Round to slightly irregular nuclei, one with a faint nuclear cleft
Moderately to markedly condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to intermediate lymphoid cells with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin, and scant basophilic cytoplasm bearing small surface blebs. Nucleoli are not conspicuous, as is typical of the small-cell variant. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia (small-cell variant) in the appropriate clinical context; immunophenotyping and TCL1A rearrangement studies are necessary for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have coarse block-like chromatin without cytoplasmic blebs and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Small Sezary cells have cerebriform nuclear grooves and are CD7/CD26-negative, unlike TCL1-positive T-PLL cells.
T-LGL cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules rather than scant blebbed basophilic cytoplasm.
